purpose: Judge Cells' own physics (resolved_pump_tissue@2: rung 1, Na K Cl Ca P M and the plasma-membrane Ca-ATPase) on BETSE's default world with the mammal ion profile against the plain-BETSE case parity-rung1-20261108-01/betse-reference/default-world-mammal-dense. DRAFT: fixed and committed by the lead before the judged runs. VERSION 2, registered after the v1 protocol FAILED on one item (SIM extracellular Ca, 4.42e-5 against 2e-5; see PROGRESS.md). Attribution (parity-rung1-20261108-01/attribution-01) found the v1 field-law proxy one-sided: it removed only BETSE's drift and never saw Cells' own exterior field. v2 adds a field term computed from blind Cells-only potentials, plus the measured Ca-pump-law term. A v2 pass is weaker evidence than a first-time pass and is reported as such.

tolerance_derivation.method: 3 x (sum of measured difference terms + X_ext), rounded up to one significant figure; per ion for concentrations (a zero sum gets the floor 1e-12)
tolerance_derivation.v2_reasoning:
Proposed v2 rung-1 tolerances: the v1 terms plus the two terms v1 did not measure.

Same pinned method: tolerance = 3 x (sum of measured terms + X_ext), rounded up to one significant
figure. Added terms (each measurable before any judged run, without BETSE results):
  calcium_pump_law_cells_vs_betse: emulator with Cells' Ca-ATPase law (its constants and the
    RT ln 1000 standard-state mapping) against BETSE's pumpCaATP (attribution-01/emulator).
  cells_exterior_field_boltzmann_response: Cells' resolved exterior potentials (blind runs)
    redistribute each mobile ion by exp(-z F (phi - <phi>) / RT) at local equilibrium. BETSE's
    field enters only through its own (scaled) drift, whose removal the v1 drift-off term sizes;
    that proxy cannot see Cells' field. ECM term: |z| F max|phi - <phi>| / RT. Cell Ca, whose
    concentration is set by the leak/pump flux balance rather than by its inventory, follows the
    exterior Ca at its patches, so the same Ca term applies to cell Ca; for the other ions the
    propagated change is the exchanged fraction of the inventory times that term (below 1e-7).
Usage: derive_v2.py RUNG_DIR OUT.json

observable_mapping: BETSE vm in this world is cell charge / (cm * sum mem_sa), uniform within a cell (Phi_b = 0; v_env not subtracted; sim.py:2029). Cells vm_ave = Q_cell / sum C_patch with C_patch = cm * mem_sa, broadcast to membranes for vm. Patch voltages and exterior potentials are diag_* arrays, reported only. Boundary-ring ECM sites are excluded: BETSE resets them each step, the resolved model holds them as reservoirs.
notes: Reported only: venv_time (BETSE's screened, smoothed estimate has no Cells counterpart) and Cells diag_* arrays.
Gate open fraction is not in the comparison layout and is not judged.
